name: platform-zero-burning
description: Platform Insentif Zero Burning - Monorepo (Backend + Frontend)

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend-web && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend-web"
scripts.db:setup: createdb -h /tmp -p 5433 -U postgres zero_burning && psql -h /tmp -p 5433 -U postgres -d zero_burning -f database/schema.sql && psql -h /tmp -p 5433 -U postgres -d zero_burning -f database/seed.sql
